style.backgroundSystem: two fields alternating screen by screen only: a charcoal blue-black field #20252B with a soft radial glow falloff for product screens, and a paper-grain pale grey plate #E8E7E3 with white rounded cards #FFFFFF for infographic screens; no third background, no reflective floor, no podium
style.direction: cool fresh botanical desk-appliance commerce, charcoal field plus paper plate
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight ring icons drawn as an outline circle with the glyph inside, white on the charcoal field and deep slate #2A3138 inside white rounded cards; one icon per claim, no filled 3D icons, no illustration shading, no pill bars
style.lightingSystem: cool soft studio key from the upper left with a low-contrast fill and a gentle radial glow falloff on the dark field, thin rim separating the shell edge, one honest contact shadow under the product, no hard speculars and no warm glow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool fresh botanical desk-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a charcoal blue-black field #20252B, a paper-grain pale grey plate #E8E7E3, one botanical green prop accent #3F7A52 and one signal red hairline accent #D93425, deep slate text #2A3138; screens alternate strictly between the dark product field and the light infographic plate; cool soft studio key from the upper left with a gentle radial glow falloff, thin rim separation and one honest contact shadow, no warm glow and no hard speculars; the product rests on the field itself, never on a stone, marble, oak or reflective podium; one oversized ghost outline latin word as the only background lettering; modern geometric sans-serif only, one small-caps latin kicker and one short signal red hairline under each headline; thin single-weight ring icons, white on the dark field and deep slate inside white rounded cards, one icon per claim; stable product scale and placement across the set and one constant light direction across matched panels; no colour palette changes, no gold or amber accents, no mixed fonts, no filled 3D icons, no invented numbers or badges, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no gold, amber or orange accent
no reflective black floor, no marble or stone podium, no oak desk surface
no mixed fonts and no filled 3D icons
no invented numbers, units, badges or certification marks
no inconsistent light direction between matched panels
style.presentationRules: product enters from a frame edge on the dark screens and is never floated on a riser; scale and single light direction held constant across matched panels; every proof cell, spec value cell and button label left blank as a placeholder
style.surfaceSystem: the product rests directly on the dark field or on the pale plate itself; only a matte pale-grey desk top #DFDCD6 inside the one lifestyle scene; no stone, marble, oak, rattan or reflective surfaces
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, two-line Chinese headlines in deep slate #2A3138 on the paper plate and in white on the charcoal field, one small-caps latin kicker per screen, one oversized ghost outline latin word as the only background lettering, one short signal red hairline #D93425 under each headline, three-layer copy budget
